Horn screws: a drop of low-strength threadlocker (Loctite 222) each (8), steel into the metal horn; none in a plastic horn.
Chicago pins bonded off the barrel head (no printed spacer under it, thinner than a print): pin:J3_leg3 0.2 mm, pin:J7_leg3 0.2 mm; set the gap with a feeler gauge while the epoxy cures.

Printed parts need about 75 g of filament at 100 % infill (71 g of PLA filament (1.24 g/cm3); 2 g of PETG filament (1.27 g/cm3); 2 g of TPU 95A flexible filament (1.22 g/cm3)); less with sparse infill.
